emma: Quick sync - storage price sheet change goes live tomorrow. Need final call on grandfathering window and dispute handling. Draft cohort: https://drive.redwood/pricing/storage-cohort-v4.csv

raj: Proposed grandfathering: accounts created before 2025-02-15 get legacy rate for next billing cycle. High-spend auto-review if monthly > $3k.

taylor: Fine, but add an audit form for manual exceptions. We had audit gaps last rollout.

billing-bot: note: flagged 2 high-spend accounts for review (acct-7782, acct-1190).

emma: OK we'll use the existing `pricing-exceptions` form and require approver email. Also accounting wants invoice tag when vendor rebates apply (`vendor_rebate_v4`). Raj can you add ETL flag?

raj: Yep, will add `vendor_rebate_v4` tag and produce a one-off reconciliation CSV for previous two cycles. PR by EOD.

taylor: Canary split 12% vs baseline. Rollback triggers: >2% MRR delta or >3% spike in disputes in 2h. Add soft alert at 0.8% MRR delta.

emma: Agreed. I'll flip 09:00 PT if no objections. Everyone ok?

raj: :thumbsup:

taylor: :thumbsup:

billing-bot: scheduled ledger snapshot at 08:55 PT for baseline.
